evidence_against: The breakout is only three bars; the preceding 27 bars overlap heavily and the region 2357-2557 can still be read as the operating trading range rather than broken.
Two earlier upside probes failed to hold: bar 110 high 2680 closed 2514.72, bar 113 high 2609.02 closed 2514.07, so upside spikes in this region have recently been rejected.
2642.90 remains below the bar-89 spike high 2771, so the whole post-spike section can be read as one broad trading range whose upper extreme has not been exceeded.

Bar 119 makes a lower high than bar 118 (2645.88 vs 2700) with a lower tail to 2568.16, a pause rather than a strong continuation bar, and bar 114 had just traded down to 2358.62 four bars before the breakout.
evidence_for: Successive higher lows and higher highs since the range low: 2357.18 -> 2358.62 -> 2413.82 -> 2436.87 and 2557.46 -> 2680 -> 2700.

Three consecutive closes above the range ceiling 2557.46 (2612.02, 2632.98, 2642.90) after bars 110 and 113 exceeded it intraday but closed back inside at 2514.72 and 2514.07 — the first sustained push beyond the ceiling.
Bar 117 is a large bull trend bar (2446.22 to 2612.02, range 206.65) closing in its top quarter, and bar 118 adds follow-through to 2700; bar 119 holds above the ceiling with a close of 2642.90.
Window-scale structure is upward: 14 bear bars to 1368.42, then a bull reversal and roughly 105 bars of rising swing lows off 1368.42.
observations: Window opens at 2116.86 and falls to 1368.42 (bar 13 low, close 1568.55), then reverses; final close 2642.90 is about +24.9% versus the first open and about +93% above the window low.
Bars 87-89 are the spike: 1916.51 to 2252.16, 2252.20 to 2326.32, 2326.31 to 2515.30, with the window high 2771 printed on bar 89.
Bars 90-116 are two-sided: overlapping bodies, highs at 2557.46 (bar 95) and 2609.02 (bar 113), lows clustered 2357.18-2425.44; bar 110 spiked to 2680 and closed 2514.72 back inside the range.

Bars 117-119 close 2612.02, 2632.98, 2642.90 — the first consecutive closes above the 2557.46 ceiling; bar 117 has open 2446.22, high 2643.52, low 2436.87, range 206.65, closing in its top quarter; bar 118 reaches 2700.

Bar 119 (open 2632.98, high 2645.88, low 2568.16, close 2642.90) is a 77.72-range bar closing near its high while holding above the range ceiling; it makes a lower high than bar 118 (2645.88 vs 2700).
Price 2642.90 remains below the bar-89 spike high 2771, so the post-spike section is not yet a confirmed new-high trend.

structures.description: Opening bear leg: a run of lower highs and lower lows from 2116.86 (first open) to 1368.42 (bar 13 low), with widening ranges into bars 9-13 (2006.06->1859.02, 1859.01->1813.04, 1813.04->1731.00, 1731.00->1581.32, 1581.32->1568.55).

Selling climax / possible mtr-like low area: bar 13 prints the window low 1368.42 with its close 1568.55 well above that low, and bar 14 reverses to close 1687.83 near its high (high 1690.78) after opening 1568.55.

Bull sequence from the window low: rising swing lows 1512.91/1533.12, 1821.49, 2357.18, 2358.62 punctuated by consolidations (about 1512-1725, 1850-1975, 2357-2557); successive bull legs reached 1954.36 (bar 59) and 2771 (bar 89).

Two-sided trading range after the bar-87..89 spike: overlapping bars between the 2357.18 low (bar 101) and the 2557.46 high (bar 95), with two upside probes that closed back inside — 2680 high closing 2514.72 (bar 110) and 2609.02 high closing 2514.07 (bar 113).

Upside breakout attempt from that range: bars 117-119 close 2612.02, 2632.98, 2642.90, the first closes above the 2557.46 ceiling, with bar 118 printing 2700, the highest high since the 2771 spike of bar 89.

transition_conditions: Continuation: additional closes above 2700 with rising closes would indicate acceptance above the range, shifting focus to the 2771 bar-89 spike high.
Failure: closes back below 2568.16 (bar 119 low) and then 2557.46 would indicate a failed breakout and a return into the 2357.18-2557.46 range.
A close below 2357.18 would remove the two-sided floor and support a broader range-breakdown or bear-leg read.
Repeated closes between 2557.46 and 2700 without progress would mark a new, higher trading range rather than a continuation trend.

evidence_against: The window is predominantly two-sided: bars 1-100 stayed inside 2357.18-2700.00 and the longest stretch (bars 17-58) held a 117.76-point inner range, so the bull leg is a fresh breakout from a range, not a long-established trend.
Bar 118 gave back 126.85 of its 191.94 range (66%) and closed in the lower third (2723.15 versus low 2658.06); 2850.00 therefore stands as a rejected spike high, not an accepted level.

Bars 119-120 contract (76.91, then 35.81 range) and their highs 2795.00 and 2770.03 fail to approach 2850.00; bar 120's 6.20-point body is a doji-like pause at the range extreme, which is also where a double top could form.

Prior spike attempts in this same window failed: bar 11 (high 2509.15) reversed two bars later at bar 17 (2523.22 open to 2450.96 close), and the bar 59 spike to 2680.00 was followed by a 321.38-point decline to 2358.62 at bar 84.
Price sits only about 60 points above the broken 2700.00 level; a move back below 2700.00 would put the market inside the old range and reclassify the breakout as failed.

Strongest alternative read: this is still a trading range (2357.18-2850.00) probing its upper extreme, with the higher-low sequence simply range oscillation rather than a channel with sustained follow-through.
evidence_for: Bars 113-120 are a one-way bull sequence: bar 113 open 2577.69 to last close 2760.51 (+182.82 points, about +7.1%), with seven of eight closes higher and the largest range bar (118, 191.94) on the upside.

The 2700.00 equal highs of bars 106 and 116 were exceeded and held: closes 2723.15, 2754.31, 2760.51 are the three highest closes in the 120-bar window, replacing the prior high close of 2664.73 at bar 116.

Six successive higher swing lows since bar 84 (2358.62, 2370.54, 2435.71, 2486.12, 2568.16, 2718.09) with no lower low for about 34 bars, including a ten-bar pullback at bars 103-112 that held above bar 101's 2495.82 low.
The bars 103-109 consolidation (2604.75-2658.79) was resolved upward, and the bar 101-102 spike closes (2578.60, 2636.28) remained the floor of all subsequent price action.

The wider window is a large base: a 2357.18/2358.62 double low with higher spike highs (2537.57, 2680.00, 2700.00) and now a break to 2850.00, i.e., the current leg is resolving a 20-day range upward.
observations: 120 closed H4 bars, first open 1788292800000, last close 1790020799999 (decision time); bars are indexed 1-120 from the oldest. Window high 2850.00 (bar 118, 1789977600000); window low 2357.18 (bar 4, 1788336000000).

structures.description: Broad two-sided range containing bars 1-117: lower boundary 2357.18 (bar 4 low, matched by 2358.62 at bar 84) and upper boundary 2700.00 (equal highs at bars 106 and 116). Most trading occurred between 2400 and 2650; bars 17-58 formed an inner 2411.04-2528.80 range and bar 59 spiked to 2680.00 before falling back.

Large double low: 2357.18 (bar 4) and 2358.62 (bar 84), with the 2680.00 spike high of bar 59 between them. The second low held 1.44 above the first, and the subsequent rally has carried about 491 points to 2850.00.

Bull leg from the bar 84 low 2358.62 to 2850.00 in two impulses: bars 86-106 up to 2700.00, a ten-bar pullback to 2568.16, then bars 113-118 to 2850.00. The pullback held well above the leg origin, but each impulse is separated by overlapping, small-bodied bars, so this reads as a leg inside the larger range rather than an established channel.

Bull breakout spike: bar 118 (open 2658.81, high 2850.00, low 2658.06, close 2723.15) cleared the 2700.00 equal highs of bars 106/116 and the 2680.00 high of bar 59. Bars 119 and 120 then closed 2754.31 and 2760.51, above 2700.00. Only one bar has traded above 2700.00 and it closed in the lower third of its range, so acceptance is not yet established.

Possible buy-climax character on bar 118: its 191.94 range is by far the largest of the last 40 bars (next largest in the leg is bar 116 at 58.30), with a 126.85 upper tail (66% of range). Bars 119-120 then contracted to 76.91 and 35.81 and stopped below 2795.00/2850.00. This names a possible exhaustion shape only; no bear reversal bar has yet printed.

transition_conditions: Bull confirmation and spike-to-channel shift: a close above 2850.00 followed by a close above 2795.00, or a shallow one-to-three-bar pullback that holds above 2718.09 (bar 119 low), keeps the bull read and moves the phase from breakout-spike toward channel.

Acceptance test: ten or more bars holding above 2700.00 without trading back inside the old range would confirm the breakout; conversely, a lower high below 2850.00 with contracting ranges would turn the spike into a range top.
Failed breakout: two consecutive closes back below 2700.00, or a strong bear bar closing below bar 118's low 2658.06, would signal failure and return the read to trading-range (2357.18-2700.00).
Trend break: a close below 2568.16 (bar 112 low) ends the sequence of higher lows and moves the regime to transition-unclear; a close below 2495.82 (bar 101 low) reopens the 2358.62 base.

Climax resolution: further range expansion above 2850.00 with a follow-through close would make bar 118 a spike inside a continuing spike rather than a buy climax; a reversal bar closing near 2658.06 would validate the climax reading.
